limitations: Branin and a 40D correlated quadratic valley are public optimization benchmarks, not engineering CAE acceptance.
ask includes model preparation/sampling and Study setup; suggestions include parameter retrieval/recording. API timings are not kernel-only timings.
CPU 1/4/8/16 are screened for sequential and scaling cases; batch comparisons use CPU/GPU 16 only.

Initial, fair and final CUB/parallel-exponential blocks are separate experiments. Final CPU16/GPU16 use the same binary in ABBA order. CPU1/4/8 screening uses the previous binary; the final changes affect GPU kernels only. Batch/reuse results remain on the previous fair binary and are not final-binary performance claims.
Cold initialization and per-seed totals are recorded; warmed summaries pool trials 513-800.
Only the good model sampling parameters return to the ordered host RNG. Mixture weights, history selection/gathering and domain checks remain host work.
CPU also reuses constructor normalizers and prepares log-sigma once; no repeated-normalizer CPU baseline is used for the best-CPU speedup.
Before/after MATLAB memory, retained device capacity and transfers are measured; whole-process peak memory and isolated transfer seconds are not.
Source-built development artifacts, not a release or a Python/DB, Rustuna or BoTorch speed comparison.
